stories.title: Trump declares victory in Iran talks
stories.summary: President Trump says a deal has been reached to end the war with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. NPR's Franco Ordoñez discusses what we know and what comes next.

stories.title: Drone strikes one of Ukraine's key Christian and cultural sites
stories.summary: Russian strikes have left cultural scars across Ukraine, damaging Kharkiv's Art Museum and striking Kyiv's historic Pechersk Lavra monastery, reminding how war reaches even sacred and storied places.

stories.title: Inside Ebola country: NPR reports from eastern DR Congo's outbreak zone
stories.summary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, an Ebola outbreak is reshaping life, with fear spreading faster than information and hospitals turning into places of urgent containment rather than care.

stories.title: Newsom points fingers at DOJ
stories.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom claims the Trump administration is targeting him and his wife.

stories.title: 'Sometimes splitting is a good thing': An Illinois movement aims to be the 51st state
stories.summary: A third of Illinois counties have passed resolutions seeking to separate from the city of Chicago. People in these rural counties resent what they see as disproportionate power wielded by Chicago.

stories.title: Ticks surge in the Northeast
stories.summary: It's prime tick season, especially in the Northeast and Midwest. The prevalence of ticks is changing the way some people in highly affected areas live their lives.
